> **Wait.** Feature requests start as [Discussions](https://github.com/wefthq/weft/discussions), not issues. Only open this if a maintainer has explicitly asked you to file an issue from a discussion thread.
>
> Reason: Weft's API surface is deliberately small. Adding to it costs forever. We need to talk through whether the thing belongs in `weft-core`, `weft-pro`, user code, or nowhere — and that conversation happens in Discussions.
